title: Chicken White Karahi
creator: Miansari66
note: Only chicken karahi at >=600px in either query ('chicken karahi', then 'karahi'): chicken pieces with green chillies in an actual karahi pan, cc0, 2816x2112, no text or people. Caveat: it is the white (yoghurt/cream) variant, not the red tomato-based one most people picture. The red candidates were rejected: 'Chicken curry' 1024x576 (short side under 600, and not titled karahi), 'My scran this evening' (IRN-BRU bottle and a plate printed with words), and Lahore Tikka House shots at 500px. Everything else returned was mutton, beef or lamb karahi. Background is a patterned tablecloth; usable but not studio quality. Swap if a red chicken karahi turns up in another batch.

title: Yellow Dal Tadka - The Indismart Hotel - Salt Lake City - Kolkata 2023-08-13 3308
creator: Biswarup Ganguly
note: Classic yellow dal tadka with coriander and whole dried chillies in a steel buffet pot, 6000x4000, sharp and well lit. Crop shifted right to keep the pot centred and to drop a small dark label at the far left edge. Alternatives: the cc0 'Sabut Moong Dal Tadka' is green whole-moong on a very busy paisley cloth; the Flickr 'Masoor Dal Tadka' is a blown-out saucepan shot.

title: •Chicken Biryani• Perfect mix of spices, rice, nuts, onions and raisins with tenderly cooked chicken pieces.

note: Unmistakable layered biryani: saffron-streaked basmati, fried onions and coriander in a white serving bowl, 1024x1024. Crop shifted down-left (924px square) to remove a glass at the top-right corner; a serving spoon remains. Rejected: 'best chicken biryani, Bangalore' shows a person's face; 'Chicken Biryani @ Srilankan' is 574px on the short side; 'Chicken Biryani by Hafees' is a pale, unappetising close-up.

title: Aloo paratha (Pokhara)

title: greek salad

note: Tomatoes, cucumber, kalamata olives, feta and oregano filling the whole frame, 1024x768, centre-cropped. 'My Big Fat Greek Salad' was the runner-up (also classic, but on a patterned plate against a dark table with more empty space); the other three were a wilted buffet bowl, a dim close-up, and a goat-cheese mixed-leaf salad that is not clearly Greek.

title: Grilled salmon with citrus sauce
creator: Khrl Zhfr
note: Grilled salmon fillet with char marks and citrus sauce on a white plate, already 1024x1024 so no crop needed; well lit, no people or text. Rejected: cc0 candidate was a phone-shot bento with a jug in frame, another was raw salmon on a grill grate, another a small fillet lost on a big plate.

title: Hummus and Avocado Plate
creator: renee_mcgurk
note: Plate with a scoop of hummus, pita wedges, olives, tomato and avocado; crop shifted right to centre the plate. Weakest of the five: avocado slices are prominent and a pink bison/heart placemat print shows below the plate (decoration, not text). Alternatives were a mezze with cucumber and only a pita edge, a dark restaurant shot with a cropped person, and a 1000x570 image below the size bar.

title: Shakshuka
creator: adactio
note: Egg poached in red tomato-pepper sauce with feta in a metal pan, filling the frame, sharp and bright; unmistakably shakshuka. The 3888px Wikimedia option was a wide table scene where the dish was a small bowl beside a mug with a logo.

title: Mmm...chicken stir fry with asparagus and carrots
creator: jeffreyw
note: Sliced chicken with asparagus and carrot in glossy sauce over rice, filling the frame, 1024x897. Rejected: a stacked-bowls styled shot with the food tiny, one result that was a garlic press, a dark in-wok shot, and a vegetable-heavy plate where the chicken was barely visible.

title: Salmon Nigiri
creator: jh_tan84
note: A single pair of salmon nigiri on a white plate with chopsticks and soft-focus cups behind; unambiguously salmon, no other fish. Crop shifted left to centre the nigiri; shortest side 680 px, just over the bar. The cc0 candidate was a party spread of rolls; the tighter close-up alternative mixed tuna and salmon nigiri.

title: とんこつラーメン Japanese Tonkotsu Ramen
creator: midnightbreakfastcafe
note: First query 'ramen bowl' yielded nothing usable (a glass ornament, an empty bowl, a stir-fry in a glass bowl, a home udon-style soup, an unappetising home bowl). Second query 'tonkotsu ramen' gave this: top-down bowl with ajitama egg, chashu, enoki, nori, spring onion and noodles in broth — unmistakably ramen, bright, 1023x768, crop shifted right to centre the bowl. The bowl rim carries a traditional printed pattern with Chinese characters (part of the crockery, not a caption or watermark); reject if that counts as text — the runner-up is Openverse 88f46d5a (AustinMatherne, CC BY 2.0), darker but with no marks at all.

title: grilled mango and tofu rice bowl
creator: Stacy Spensley
note: Close-up white bowl of seared tofu strips with mango and red pepper over white rice; the tofu and rice are both clearly visible, fills the frame, 1024x768, centre crop. The CC0 Wikimedia alternative (e408894a, 8160x6144) was rejected because it sits on a printed menu with readable text and a person's arm at the top-left; the other flickr result at 500x500 was under the size floor.

title: Mmm... roasted vegetables with American fries and grilled marinated chicken
creator: jeffreyw

title: Pulled Chicken Taco Salad
creator: HealthHomeHappy.com

title: Chicken Shawarma Plate
creator: Shoshanah

The larger Wikimedia candidates (CC BY 4.0) were a shawarma in a flatbread and a loaded shawarma mound, less recognisable as a plate; the CC0 candidate was a mixed beef/chicken wrap with fries and carried a watermark-free but generic look.

title: Falafel Wrap from Sunrise Deli Saturday at SoMa StrEat Food Park
creator: Gary Soup
note: Pita-wrapped falafel with lettuce and tahini on foil on a wooden table, 1024x768, evenly lit, unmistakably a falafel wrap. The visually stronger candidate (SaucyGlo's halved wrap on a paper plate) is 1024x577 and fails the 600 px short-side rule; the other options had a hand holding the wrap, diners in frame, or were a loose foil close-up dominated by slaw.
